CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Divisions of has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Divisions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Divisions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

5. Which response best shows understanding of Sharing Values? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sharing Values.
   B. Say Sharing Values has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Sharing Values to insult classmates of other faiths.

   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Self- Awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness.
   C. Say Self- Awareness has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus.
   C. Say Jesus has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Jesus to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
